model: pinhole + one radial term: x = Xc/Zc, y = Yc/Zc, d = 1 + k1 (x^2 + y^2), u = fx x d + W/2, v = fx y d + H/2 (camera: +z forward, +x right, +y down)

wrist.transform: T_flange_cam: camera -> flange, the twin's J6_link frame (wrist centre, tool along +x); compose with the FK of the joints

table_depth.model: pinhole, no distortion (rectified by the camera): u = fx X/Z + cx, v = fy Y/Z + cy
table_depth.transform: the depth camera's pose in the base frame (camera: +z forward, +x right, +y down)
table_depth.notes: Factory intrinsics and depth-to-colour extrinsics, on the table colour camera's pose, then tilted and shifted in z onto the work surface. Depth is the distance along the optical axis (Z), in mm; 0 = none.

wrist_depth.model: pinhole, no distortion (rectified by the camera): u = fx X/Z + cx, v = fy Y/Z + cy
wrist_depth.transform: T_flange_cam: depth camera -> flange (the twin's J6_link frame); compose with the FK of the joints the depth came with (camera: +z forward, +x right, +y down)
wrist_depth.notes: Factory intrinsics and depth-to-colour extrinsics on the wrist colour camera's flange pose, then tilted and shifted onto the work surface at solved_at_joints. Depth: mm along the optical axis; 0 = none.
